steps.title: Capstone Overview
steps.text: This capstone unit combines everything from the bootcamp into complete, production-ready patterns across five real-world scenarios.

steps.title: Pattern Integration
steps.text: Each lesson combines multiple Surgewave concepts: messaging with streams for e-commerce, aggregation for IoT, integration with streams for log analytics, and more.

steps.title: Architecture Principles
steps.text: Apply event-driven design, loose coupling via topics, event sourcing as source of truth, CQRS for separate read/write models, and the saga pattern for distributed transactions.

steps.title: What You Will Build
steps.text: Build an e-commerce pipeline, IoT data platform, centralized log analytics, event sourcing with projections, and microservices communication with sagas.

steps.title: Tips for Success
steps.text: Start simple and build incrementally, run and experiment with examples, think in events not data, consider failure modes, and design for horizontal scaling.
